ondertitel: 300 Would You Rather Questions for Couples: Funny, Romantic and Thought-Provoking Date Night Game. A Valentine's Day Gift for Him or Her
zoekwoorden: date night ideas game for couples
beschrijving_html:
One question. Two answers. Endless fun.

Would you rather read each other's minds or never have a secret again? Slow dance in the kitchen or dance at a big party?

Choose Wisely, Darling is packed with 300 funny, romantic and thought-provoking Would You Rather questions for couples. Read one out loud, both pick an answer, and then explain why. That is where the laughs, the debates and the surprises begin.

Inside you'll find:

  • 300 questions in 12 chapters: warm-up laughs, date night, food fights, travel, home, sweet and romantic, superpowers, money and dreams, embarrassing moments, movie night, deep talk and your future together
  • Space to mark both of your answers
  • Clean, playful questions, from silly to sweet to deep

A gift for the two of you

A fun Valentine's Day, anniversary or date night gift for husbands, wives, boyfriends and girlfriends. Perfect for road trips, cozy nights in and no-phone dinners.

Scroll up and start your next great conversation.
